requirements.text: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of professional software engineering experience building and delivering production systems.
Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Go, Java, C++, or Python.
Experience developing backend services, APIs, or distributed systems.
Understanding of core computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and system design.
Experience writing maintainable, well-tested production code.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional partners.
Experience building scalable, high-throughput, or low-latency backend systems.
Familiarity with search, recommendation, information retrieval, ranking, or ML-powered systems.
Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, or ML model-serving systems and an interest in applying them to large-scale search.
Experience with embeddings, semantic retrieval, approximate nearest-neighbor search, or vector search.
Experience building or integrating LLM-powered applications, retrieval/ranking systems, or evaluation pipelines.
Familiarity with model-serving or inference concepts such as batching, caching, streaming, or latency optimization.
Experience with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, Vespa, Lucene, or similar retrieval systems.
Familiarity with distributed systems and technologies such as Kafka, Redis, Cassandra, Spark, or Flink.
Experience with performance optimization, monitoring, observability, and production debugging.
Experience working on large-scale consumer-facing products.
